summary: Safe Bulkers, Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the opening price and trading symbol for its common stock on Euronext Athens, a secondary listing. The opening price is set at €5.70, derived from the NYSE closing price of $6.62 as of June 1, 2026, converted at the ECB reference rate. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure of the listing mechanics, including ISIN MHY7388L1039. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, tender offers, or restructuring. This is a standard foreign private issuer report on a securities listing arrangement.
